prompts.valves:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production 2D sprite atlas for ORDRE DE CENDRE, an original grounded military science-fiction game. One atlas, EXACTLY 6 isolated sprites, strict 3 columns by 2 rows on a 1536x1024 canvas. Cell dimensions512x512. Do not draw grid, border, labels, lettering, numbers, background, floor or cast shadows. Actual RGBA transparency. All objects entirely inside cells with generous 30px transparent gutters. Hand-painted detailed matte graphite and weathered sage steel, tarnished copper pipes, restrained ochre status lights, Kharon industrial foundry palette. Strict orthographic side view, clear silhouettes, no isometric perspective.
First five cells contain the SAME upright compact steam isolation valve body on broad short metal footing. Its pipe bends up on the RIGHT into a vertical outlet, and a waist-high pump block projects to the LEFT. At chest height a small round axle hub accepts a handwheel, but there is NO HANDWHEEL on any body: a separate movable wheel will be attached in code. Same shape, same fixed scale and identical footing/baseline at y455 within each cell, body approximately300px wide and370px high. Top row left-to-right: 1 closed, intact matte body with muted amber pilot light; 2 pressure warning, same body with clear bright ochre gauge segment and warning lamp; 3 active pressure, same body with opened outlet shutter and hot orange gauge, no steam drawn. Bottom row: 4 isolated/open circuit, same intact valve with steady pale mint pilot and open service latch, outlet closed; 5 destroyed, broken dark valve block and bent disconnected outlet collapsed close around same footing, no flames, smoke or extra debris outside base; 6 a SINGLE detached intact circular handwheel, seen straight on, four spokes and a central axle socket, aged brass rim about180px diameter centered in cell, no body and no other part. Handwheel must be perfectly circular and symmetrical so rotation is clean. The five valve bodies share the same construction and physical size; ruined state shorter, never enlarged. Clear true transparent background.
